messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from behind. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on the road, turns to her left to face the camera in profile, then turns back to face away from the camera.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium shot from behind the character.","clothing":"A bright pink long-sleeved collared jacket and a matching pink flared skirt.","hair_color":"Yellow.","hairstyle":"Bright yellow hair styled into two high buns on either side of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with dark skin, shown from behind and in profile.","scene":"An outdoor paved road with white lane markings, bordered by a metal guardrail, trees with yellow and green leaves, a concrete wall, and a construction crane in the distance under a blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static medium/upper-body shot from behind the character, matching the reference's rear view and framing. The character remains in a pink jacket and skirt on a road, turns to profile, and turns back, with the same general action progression. The scene is now viewed from the opposite direction, showing a road, guardrail, trees, wall, and crane instead of the original underpass and construction barriers.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to an upper-body shot from behind, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, scene, timing, and progression.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved, since the face is mostly hidden from the rear camera angle.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair is now bright yellow with two high buns, whereas the source showed a different hairstyle and color progression.
The visible background changed to the opposite side of the road, with different landmarks and framing than the source's underpass view.
The character's face is not visible in the output, so the original expression cannot be confirmed.
